class.name: NNActionGroup
class.brief_description: Creates sequences of actions, or picks one random action from several choices.
class.description: This node type should be added as child nodes of the [NNBehaviour] node. They are used when a behaviour is being executed by the AI agent. Action groups can be used to create sequences of actions, pick one random action from several choices, branch with an if/else condition, or select actions with a custom script rule. This allows for more complex actions to be performed by a behaviour. You can nest as many action groups as you need, and they can contain any number and combination of actions or action groups. With [code]PickOneAtRandom[/code], only enabled child actions and action groups are candidates when the group starts; if none are enabled, or if the chosen child is later disabled, the group does not reroll and ends without running another child. With [code]IfElse[/code], if the chosen branch (child 0 or child 1) is missing or disabled, the group does not fall back to the other branch and ends without running an action.

method.name: on_select_child
method.description: Called by the [code]CustomRule[/code] execution rule whenever the group needs its next child. Return the index of an enabled [NNAction] or [NNActionGroup] child to run, or [code]-1[/code] to end the group. When not overridden, the group runs no child under [code]CustomRule[/code].

members.member: How child actions and nested action groups are executed: [code]Sequence[/code] ([code]0[/code]), [code]PickOneAtRandom[/code] ([code]1[/code]), [code]IfElse[/code] ([code]2[/code]), or [code]CustomRule[/code] ([code]3[/code]). [code]Sequence[/code] executes enabled child actions from top to bottom, skipping disabled ones. [code]PickOneAtRandom[/code] picks one enabled child uniformly at random when the group starts. [code]IfElse[/code] uses [member if_else_boolean_value] to choose child 0 ([code]true[/code]) or child 1 ([code]false[/code]). [code]CustomRule[/code] calls [method on_select_child] when the group starts (with [member current_action_index] reset to [code]-1[/code]) and again whenever the group needs the next child (after a child finishes, becomes disabled, fails under [code]ContinueExecution[/code], or if [method on_select_child] returned [code]-1[/code] on start). It returns the index of an enabled child to run, or [code]-1[/code] to end the group.

The child index of the currently active [NNAction] or nested [NNActionGroup]. Defaults to [code]0[/code] before the group has run, and is set to [code]-1[/code] when the group ends. Under the [code]CustomRule[/code] execution rule it is assigned the value returned by [method on_select_child], which selects the child index to run or [code]-1[/code] to stop the group.

How a child that finishes with [member NNActions.has_failed] set is handled: [code]EndExecution[/code] ([code]0[/code]) or [code]ContinueExecution[/code] ([code]1[/code]). A direct [NNAction] child failure emits [signal action_failed] under both rules. [code]EndExecution[/code] stops the group and sets [member NNActions.has_failed] to [code]true[/code], so its parent treats the whole group as failed. [code]ContinueExecution[/code] leaves [member NNActions.has_failed] [code]false[/code] and continues with [member action_execution_rule].

The condition used by the [code]IfElse[/code] execution rule: [code]true[/code] runs child index [code]0[/code], [code]false[/code] runs child index [code]1[/code]. If the chosen child is missing or disabled, the group ends without running the other branch.

signal.name: action_failed
signal.description: Emitted when a child [param action_node] of this group finishes with [member NNActions.has_failed] set. With the EndExecution [member error_handling_rule] the group is marked as failed before the signal is emitted.
